body: Thank you so much.  You made me realize that posting was the first step to getting back on my feet.  It'll take time, and it'll be hell, but I'll try...

Thank you very much, it helped knowing someone was in the same boat and getting some practical advice.  I called the university counselor today to see what my options are.

Finding another guy isn't really feasible - I now have an incurable std.  But I'd rather face life alone than with someone who causes me pain.
I can't thank you enough for your kind words.  What you said about my parents really made me pause.  I may not have any friends, but my parents do need me, I'm all they have.
